title: Swipe-to-seek feedback placement
prompt: On Linux, update swipe-to-seek feedback so a horizontal swipe shows the target position, duration, and progress in the bottom folder line while swiping. Do not show a center seek indicator. The temporary feedback must clear after the gesture. Provide during-gesture and post-gesture screenshots.

network.reason: Candidate traffic is isolated on a fresh internal network and may leave only through the exact-host HTTPS proxy allowlist.
